name: Checkbox
description: Turns one option on or off, or selects items in a list or table. Supports the indeterminate (mixed) state.

props.name: checked
props.description: Whether it's checked. Livewire binds it with wire:model, Vue with v-model:checked. Emitted as data-state.

props.name: defaultChecked
props.description: The initial state of an uncontrolled checkbox.

props.name: indeterminate
props.description: Shows the mixed state, such as a select-all box with some rows selected. Emitted as data-state="indeterminate".
props.a11y: Sets the native indeterminate property, so it is announced as mixed.

props.name: label
props.description: The visible label, linked to the control.

props.name: description
props.description: Supporting text under the label, linked with aria-describedby.

props.name: error
props.description: Validation message. Marks it invalid and is linked with aria-describedby.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Marks it invalid without a message. Emitted as data-invalid.

props.name: required
props.description: Marks it required, such as consent to terms.

props.name: errorField
props.description: The validation key to read from $errors. Defaults to the wire:model name.

props.name: classes
props.description: Extra classes per part, such as { box: '…', label: '…' }.

parts.name: root
parts.description: The box, label, description and error.

parts.name: box
parts.description: The visible square. The native control covers it.

parts.name: control
parts.description: The native checkbox, visually hidden over the box. Attributes other than class land here.

parts.name: indicator
parts.description: The check, or the dash when indeterminate.

parts.name: label
parts.description: The visible label, for the control.

events.name: checked-change
events.description: The checked state changed. Clearing indeterminate is up to the owner.

requirements: The native input type=checkbox stays in the DOM, visually hidden over the box, so the platform handles keyboard and screen readers.
Indeterminate sets the native indeterminate property, announced as mixed.
The label is linked with for/id; description and error with aria-describedby.
The hit area covers the box plus 4px, and the label toggles it too.
Disabled uses --apui-surface-sunken and --apui-text-disabled, never opacity alone.
Visible focus ring on the box while the control has :focus-visible.
Use Toggle, not Checkbox, for settings that apply instantly.
